summary: The candidate is correct under the supplied predecessor conventions. The closed-cap formula gives the stated strict-chord/open-interior minimum, including singleton supports, support endpoints, zero cutoff, and tied chord heights. Discrete ratio monotonicity proves the Mills estimates and baseline bound. Convex interpolation and outward slopes prove the interior and tail estimates; combining them with medianity yields the distance and rise bounds without a height assumption. The analytic estimates establish the uniform integer bound 11 on the stated p interval. The balanced case and the sufficient lopsided criterion follow with the stated constants. No claim that the remaining lopsided cases or a global one-half theorem are proved is made.
